info.title: PFP Brawl API
info.description: Ambient match-record data for PFP Brawl, a generalized fighting game engine (see ADAPTERS.md). Tracks how many times each token ID has fought and won/lost in-game, namespaced per adapter via the `adapter` param (each adapter's own `config.key` from src/adapters/*/index.js) so two different collections' token #42 never share a record. Omitting `adapter` falls back to `onchainhoodies` for backward compatibility with clients built before this param existed. Unauthenticated by design, same trust model as the rest of the game (no wallet writes, nothing on-chain) - this is a fun social signal, not a verified competitive record. Source: https://github.com/Pixelpushin/pfp-brawl. Not deployed yet - no `servers` entry until a real deployment exists (see README's Deploying section).

get.summary: Get a token's in-game fight record

parameters.name: adapter
parameters.description: Which adapter's namespace to read from (matches that adapter's config.key). Defaults to onchainhoodies.

get.summary: Get the most recent completed matches for one adapter's collection

parameters.description: Which adapter's namespace to read from (matches that adapter's config.key). Defaults to onchainhoodies.

post.summary: Record the outcome of a completed match for one token
post.description: Called by the game client itself when a match ends. Unauthenticated - not designed to resist abuse, treat resulting stats as an ambient/fun signal rather than a verified record.

adapter.description: Which adapter's namespace to write to (matches that adapter's config.key). Defaults to onchainhoodies.
